name: web-nft-creator-dashboard-with-lime-active-states-and-ai-art-engine
title: NFT Creator Dashboard with Lime Accents
whatItIs: A beige rounded dashboard with a black icon rail with a lime active item, a minting profile, earnings donut with coin icons and a payouts table, a gallery of NFT cards with a black active card and lime button, a performance line chart and a dark AI Art Engine card with a lime Generate pill.
whatItMeans: Lime marks what is active on black and beige, and the mix of card types keeps a dense dashboard readable.
techniques: Lime as the active-state colour on a black rail
One black card among white gallery cards
Dark AI card as a feature block
Warm beige shell with white panels

vocabulary.definition: A narrow vertical bar of navigation icons.
The card styled differently to show selection.
A dark tile promoting a special tool.
